newsitem.title: POLAND: ELEKTRIM SELLS PLN 466 MLN IN BONDS.
newsitem.headline: ELEKTRIM SELLS PLN 466 MLN IN BONDS.

text.p: Polish trading and industrial conglomerate Elektrim SA has sold 466.3-million-zlotys worth of its seven-year convertible bond, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
In January Elektrim said its convertible bond issue would amount to 550 million zlotys.
The statement said the issue's managers, Merrill Lynch International and Polish state-owned bank Pekao SA, could increase the issue by 83.7 million zlotys.
It said the bonds carried a yearly coupon of two percent and that they could be redeemed after five years at 115.3 percent of their par value calculated in marks.
The statement also said the bonds could be exchanged into 57,209 shares each.
Elektrim has said it plans to issue up to 19 million shares to be exchanged for the bonds.
